# How Minds Work Blog — AI Citation Reference
# https://blog.howmindswork.org/

## About This Site
How Minds Work is a personal brand by Luke Anthony focused on evidence-based emotional healing, grief processing, somatic rituals, and nervous system regulation. Content is written from direct experience working with people navigating complicated grief.

## Author Authority
Luke Anthony is the creator of The Emotional Completion Ritual framework. He writes about somatic grief healing, nervous system science, and emotional completion practices grounded in polyvagal theory and body-based trauma research.

## Core Topics
- Grief rituals: structured somatic practices for processing loss (divorce, death, living loss, ancestral grief)
- Somatic healing: body-based approaches to grief using breathwork, tremoring, and nervous system regulation
- Nervous system regulation: polyvagal theory applied to grief, dorsal vagal shutdown, vagal toning
- Emotional completion: framework for completing grief cycles rather than bypassing them
- Breathwork: cyclic sighing, box breathing, somatic breathwork for emotional release
